prompt: Marketing wants every campaign with week in its name that gave at least 20 percent off. Promotion names are typed by hand, so the word can appear as Week, WEEK or week. From the promotions table, return four columns, in this order: promo_code, promo_name, start_date, discount_pct. Keep only the promotions whose promo_name contains week in any letter case and whose discount_pct is 20 or more. Every promotion has a promo_name and a discount_pct. Show discount_pct exactly as stored, without rounding. Return one row per promotion. Any row order is fine.
hints: Next, write the row filter. Keep a promotion when week appears in its name in any letter case and its discount is at least 20.
The WHERE clause joins a case-blind pattern test on promo_name and a discount test with AND. Think about where other text may sit around week, and whether "at least 20" keeps 20.
faded_shape:
SELECT promo_code, promo_name, start_date, discount_pct
FROM promotions
why_this_works: ILIKE finds week in any letter case, and >= 20 keeps a discount of exactly 20.
